name: Poker
summary: Classic 52-card gambling game where players bet into a pot trying to win with the best five-card hand.
rules_text: Poker uses a standard 52-card deck. Each player is dealt a hand. Hand strength from high to low is: Royal Flush, Straight Flush, Four of a Kind, Full House, Flush, Straight, Three of a Kind, Two Pair, Pair, High Card. Aces are high. There are multiple betting rounds in clockwise order. If no bet exists you may Check or Bet. If a bet exists you may Fold, Call by matching the current bet, or Raise by matching and increasing it. Betting round ends when all active players have matched the highest bet or checked, or all but one fold. If all but one folds, that player wins pot immediately. If betting concludes with two or more players, showdown occurs and highest remaining hand wins entire pot.
rating_reason: Classic hidden hand, bluffing, bidding, payoff matrix ideal for engine.
